rows.en: I'm sorry for pushing you to buy something.
You really bought it! Thank you! I love you! Kira!
You always buy things for me. Thank you.
Thank you so, so much for buying!
I'll be waiting for you to come again!
I believe you'll come back! Kira!
I was so nervous! You were my customer!
You were just browsing? That's mean.
Next time I'll definitely make you buy something! It's my revenge!
I believe you'll buy something next time!
Um, nice to meet you! I'm Ranka Lee, and I'll explain the basic controls for Fighter mode!
During training, flight mode is Normal Flight and the controller settings are reset to default, so be careful.
Press up on the D-pad to lower the nose and descend, and down to raise the nose and climb.
Press left or right on the D-pad to turn.
Hold the L button and press left or right on the D-pad to yaw.
Press the Cross button to boost. You can boost until the boost gauge is maxed out.
rows.notes: Kept literal (the gauge fills as you boost); check against the game's own tutorial text.

rows.en: Press up, left or right on the D-pad twice quickly in the same direction to roll that way. You are invincible while rolling.
Press down on the D-pad twice quickly to fire the reverse thrusters and brake hard.
Hold the Triangle button to brake and slow down.
Press up on the analog stick to transform into Fighter mode. Alto really is amazing. I'd get so dizzy!
rows.notes: Source says "up on the analog stick transforms to Fighter"; kept as heard.

rows.en: That's the basic Fighter controls. Oh, and in this training you can't transform out of Fighter mode, so be careful!
Now please go through the Fighter flight training.
Training ends when you reach the target area or time runs out.
Target area reached. Ending Fighter flight training.
Training time is up. Ending Fighter flight training.
I'll explain the basic controls for GERWALK mode.
During training, the controller settings are reset to default, so be careful.
Press left or right on the D-pad to turn.
Press the D-pad twice quickly in the same direction to step that way.
Keep holding the D-pad at the end of a step to dash.
Hold the Cross button to boost upward and gain altitude.
In GERWALK mode you keep your position and float, hovering.
Press the Cross button twice quickly and keep holding it to boost downward and lose altitude.
rows.notes: Heard "kakou boost" (processing boost); read as "kakou boost" (descent boost).

rows.en: Press left or right on the analog stick to transform into GERWALK mode.
That's the basic GERWALK controls. Also, in this training you can't transform out of GERWALK mode, so be careful!
It's kind of like the Battroid controls, isn't it? Hovering around all floaty looks like fun!
rows.notes: Last word heard as "tanoshisa" (fun-ness); read as "tanoshisou"/"tanoshii".

rows.en: Now please go through the GERWALK flight training.
Target area reached. Ending GERWALK flight training.
Training time is up. Ending GERWALK flight training.
I'll explain the basics of melee attacks.
In GERWALK and Battroid modes, press the Triangle button for a melee attack.
Press the Triangle button repeatedly to chain melee attacks.
The number of chained attacks depends on the machine and mode.
Hold the Triangle button briefly and release it for a charged melee attack.
Press the Triangle button while dashing for a dash melee attack.
In Battroid mode, press down on the D-pad while attacking in melee for a launching melee attack.
A launched enemy is defenseless for a short time. You can keep attacking during that time.
In Battroid mode, press the Triangle button against a downed enemy for a down attack.
Um, Fighter mode has no melee attacks, so be careful!
That's the basics of melee attacks.
Target area reached. Ending melee attack training.
Training time is up. Ending melee attack training.
I'll explain Special Maneuvers 2.
Hold the L button and press the Circle button to spend 1 block of the SP Gauge on a Charge Shot.
Hold the L button and press the Triangle button to spend 1 block of the SP Gauge on a Charge Melee.
Fighter mode can't use Charge Melee. Please be careful.
Hold the L button and press the Cross button to spend 1 block of the SP Gauge on a Charge Boost.
A Fighter-mode Charge Boost counts as a melee attack.
In Battroid and GERWALK modes, press the Triangle button during a Charge Boost for a melee attack.
Press the Triangle and Circle buttons together to spend 3 blocks of the SP Gauge on a powerful Special Attack.
Press the Circle and Cross buttons together to spend a set number of blocks and use a Support Skill.
Press the Circle and Cross buttons together to spend a set number of blocks and use a Command Skill.
Hold the L button and press the Triangle and Circle buttons together for a combined Special Attack with both units.
rows.notes: "Both units" (ryouki) read as both allied units (player and partner); not confirmed.

rows.en: A combined Special Attack costs 3 blocks of the SP Gauge.
That's the basics of Special Maneuvers 2.
Target area reached. Ending Special Maneuvers 2 training.
Training time is up. Ending Special Maneuvers 2 training.
I'm Ranka Lee! I'll explain the newly added and changed controls!
These are the new Fighter mode controls, right?
During training, flight mode is Real Flight, and the controller settings are reset to default, so be careful.
Press left or right on the D-pad to roll.
Press the Cross button to boost. You can boost until the boost gauge is maxed out.
In Real Flight, hold the R button while locked on and the camera turns to the target.
Sheryl! I spun around and around and got so dizzy!
Now please go through the Real Flight training.
Target area reached. Ending Real Flight training.
Training time is up. Ending Real Flight training.
Um, this explains the new Special Maneuvers and the changed controls.
Fighter mode no longer has Charge Melee. But now it can do a Charge Boost that counts as a melee attack!
So you can use the skills of the character you set as support?
